title: The Poisonous Potato Update
description: This mod intends to bring features from the legendary Poisonous Potato Update to recent Minecraft versions.
body:
**This mod adds features from the legendary _Poisonous Potato Update_ to Minecraft!**


## Features:

- Poisonous Potatoes can now be used in a stonecutter. They can be sliced into Poisonous Potato Slices or Poisonous Potato Sticks.
- Poisonous Potato Slices can be smelted (or smoked) into Poisonous Potato Chips.
- Poisonous Potato Sticks can be smelted (or smoked) into Poisonous Potato Fries.
- Golden Poisonous Potatoes can be crafted with a Poisonous Potato in the middle surrounded by Gold Ingots.
- Enchanted Golden Poisonous Potatoes can be crafted with a Poisonous Potato in the middle surrounded by Blocks of Gold.

- Added the Poisonous Potato Hammer. It is a new weapon, automatically enchanted with Knockback X, that can be crafted with a Blaze Rod and a Poisonous Potato on top.
- Added the Toxic Beam, dropped by Poisoned Guardians.
- Added the Lashing Potato. It is a sort of grappling hook, that can be crafted with a Toxic Beam and a Poisonous Potato Block.

- Added Poisonous Potato Blocks.
- Added the Floatato block, which can be placed mid-air without supporting blocks, and can be crafted with a Ghast Tear in the middle surrounded by Poisonous Potatoes.
- These blocks drop with any tool, but are mined faster with a hoe.

- Added new Potatofication enchantment. 
- It is found in Village chests, and can only be applied to a hoe. 
- Potato crops drop more Potatoes and Poisonous Potatoes when harvested with a hoe enchanted with any level of Potatofication (levels I through V).

- Added 7 new paintings.
- Changed the End poem.
- Changed menu splashes.


## Technical data:

- Supported languages:
  - English (US)
  - English (UK)
  
    Don't hesitate to ask me to add support to your language!

- Food effects:
  - Poisonous Potato Slices restore 1 hunger point and 1.2 saturation points.
  - Poisonous Potato Sticks restore 1 hunger point and 1.2 saturation points.
  - Poisonous Potato Chips restore 8 hunger point and 10 saturation points.
  - Poisonous Potato Fries restore 10 hunger point and 12 saturation points.
  - Golden Poisonous Potatoes restore 2 hunger points and 4.8 saturation points, as well as granting Absorption I for 2 minutes, and Poison II for 5 seconds.
  - Enchanted Golden Poisonous Potatoes restore 2 hunger points and 4.8 saturation points, as well as granting Absorption IV for 2 minutes, Poison VIII for 20 seconds, Luck and Bad Luck for 5 minutes.

- Weapons and tools:
  - The Poisonous Potato Hammer has an attack damage of 11 (1 more than a Netherite Axe), and an attack speed of 6 (much faster than any weapon).
  - The Toxic Beam has a 25% drop rate from poisoned Guardians killed by the player, and each level of Looting adds 5% to the total chances.

- Poisonous Potato Blocks:
  - You can craft 9 Poisonous Potatoes into a Poisonous Potato Block.
  - You can craft 9 Poisonous Potato Blocks into a Compressed Poisonous Potato Block.
  - You can craft 9 Compressed Poisonous Potato Blocks into a Double Compressed Poisonous Potato Block.
  - You can craft 9 Double Compressed Poisonous Potato Blocks into a Triple Compressed Poisonous Potato Block.
  - You can craft 9 Triple Compressed Poisonous Potato Blocks into a Quadruple Compressed Poisonous Potato Block.
  - You can reverse these crafts.
  - One single Quadruple Compressed Poisonous Potato Block requires 59,049 Poisonous Potatoes (approximately 923 stacks of 64 or 34.2 shulker boxes).

- The Potatofication enchantment 
  - It has a 25% chance of being found in any Village chest, at a random level.
  - The number of potatoes dropped is calculated in the following way:

<details>
<summary>WARNING: VERY HARDCORE MATH</summary>

      Split the level into two non-negative integers n and m.
      For Potatofication I, only valid splits are 1+0 and 0+1. 
      For Potatofication V, valid splits include 5+0, 4+1, 3+2, 2+3, 1+4 and 0+5.
      Drop n² poisonous potatoes and m² regular potatoes.

</details>


## Known Issues:

- Wrong rarity for the Poisonous Potato Hammer if using /give.
- Can break blocks in Creative when holding the Poisonous Potato Hammer.
- The Lashing Potato hook disappears when its length is larger than a certain limit.


## Other:

- Most of these informations are available on the wiki.
- You may fork this mod however you like, I only demand that you put a link to it on your mod page.
- If you find any issue/bug, please contact me.
- Discord username: kapputkat.
